name: sanctions-entity-explorer
description: Run the Sanctions Entity Explorer backend and frontend together from the repo root.

scripts.setup: uv sync --directory backend && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.check: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend pytest && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend test && pnpm --dir frontend build
